title: OJAJ etap II gram.-leks.: opis zdjecia

tasks.instruction: Ponizszy opis dotyczy zdjecia, na ktorym dziewczynka bawi sie z dwoma psami nad strumieniem. Uzupelnij opis tak, aby byl poprawny gramatycznie i logiczny.

items.stem: The dog _________ the girl is white.
Neither dog _________ standing on all four legs.
The dogs are trying to get the stick the girl is holding in _________ hand.

tasks.text: In this photo there are two dogs and a girl playing. The dog 1. _________ the girl is white and is wearing a blue 2. _________. 3. _________ dog is black. Neither dog 4. _________ standing on all four legs. The dogs are trying to get the stick the girl is holding in 5. _________ hand.
